system_configurations.name: RCCL-AINIC-ABC
system_configurations.description: AINIC test plan for Surya. Group A: NetIbMPI + GIN component/unit tests (2 nodes x 1 GPU = 2 ranks). Group B: NCCL_NET plugin x knobs sweep on rccl-tests perf (2 nodes x 8 GPU = 16 ranks), including out-of-the-box autodetect. Group C: IONIC hardware counter validation. Run on the AINIC cluster with --system ainic.

mpi_args.ainic: --mca oob_tcp_if_include eno0 --mca btl_tcp_if_include eno0 --mca btl ^vader,openib --bind-to none

test_configurations._comment_group_a: === GROUP A: component / unit tests (rccl-UnitTestsMPI). 2 nodes x 1 GPU = 2 ranks. ===

a_netib_component._comment: A1-A3: core NetIb plugin init / properties / data path on AINIC (IB-CAST plugin + libionic.so).

tests.name: A1_NetIB_InitializePlugin
tests.description: Verifies IB-CAST plugin init and libionic.so load on AINIC.

tests.name: A2_NetIB_GetDeviceProperties
tests.description: Verifies IONIC devices (rdma0+) are visible and properties valid.

tests.name: A3_NetIB_SimpleSendRecv
tests.description: Verifies basic send/recv over AINIC data path (no collectives).

a_cts_workaround._comment: A4: CTS-off P2P stress, sized to PASS cleanly. 16 conns x 64 = 1024 outstanding recvs; with RCCL_IB_P2P_DISABLE_CTS=1 all entries drain (retx=0, ack_timeout=0, 1024/1024 completions) and the test returns 0. Empirically on g27/g28 (job 9439) <=2048 outstanding drains cleanly; >=4096 stalls (drain timeout) which is the CTS match-table depth limit reproduced separately by A5. Do NOT bump CTS_QP_DEPTH back to 256 here or A4 will time out.

tests.name: A4_NetIB_CtsDepthStress_CtsOff
tests.description: CTS-off P2P stress path passes cleanly (1024 outstanding recvs drain fully).

a_cts_overflow._comment: A5: CTS-on overflow reproducer (expected timeout/hang on AINIC).

tests.name: A5_NetIB_CtsDepthStress_CtsOn
tests.description: Reproduces AINIC CTS match-table overflow (~256 entries); expected to time out.

a_cast_base._comment: CAST white-box tests REQUIRE the full WRR env set (the test guard checks every var, incl. RCCL_IB_QP_SCHED_WEIGHT) or they GTEST_SKIP. Env-only base (no tests) so children that extend it do not inherit each other's test lists. Mirrors cast_base in net_ib_transport.json.

tests.name: A7_Cast_EqualWeightsTwoQPsTokenCounts
tests.description: WRR scheduler balances 2 QPs without corruption (token table sane).

tests.name: A8_Cast_SingleQPBypassesWrr
tests.description: Single-QP connection bypasses WRR scheduler initialisation (keep sched enabled; just drop to 1 QP).

a_fault_inject._comment: A9: per-QP fault injection on CAST path. Extends a_cast_base (NOT a_cast_wrr) so it does not inherit A7/A8.

tests.name: A9_Cast_FaultInjQpErrorIsFatal
tests.description: QP fault is detected (fatal) and does not corrupt other QPs on CAST path.

a_gin._comment: A10-A15: GIN one-sided proxy tests. Gated at build by RCCL_HAS_GIN_IB_PROXY; require NCCL_NET=ib-cast (else GTEST_SKIP). Parameterized fixtures use wildcard filters.

tests.name: A10_Gin_IPutBasic
tests.description: GIN one-sided iput RDMA write over AINIC.

tests.name: A11_Gin_IGetBasic
tests.description: GIN one-sided iget RDMA read over AINIC.

tests.name: A12_Gin_IPutSignal
tests.description: GIN put-with-signal (atomic inc/add) completion semantics.

tests.name: A13_Gin_IFlushAfterIGet
tests.description: GIN GPU flush ordering after iget.

tests.name: A14_Gin_MultipleInflight
tests.description: Multiple outstanding GIN iput/iget complete without corruption.

tests.name: A15_Gin_IPutSignalStress10k
tests.description: Stress: 10k put-with-signal ops, signal counter must equal 10000 (no drops).

test_configurations._comment_group_b: === GROUP B: NCCL_NET plugin x knobs sweep on rccl-tests perf. 2 nodes x 8 GPU = 16 ranks. ===

b_base._comment: Sweep base. command_args here (-e 8G) is inherited by the allreduce tests, which are healthy to 8G. The alltoall tests OVERRIDE command_args to -e 128M because CAST/ROCM-IB alltoall >=256M hits a real RCCL bug (IbCastCompletionEventProcess: expected 'recv' got 'Unused' -> internal error); the 8G alltoall repro lives in the disabled b_large_alltoall_repro suite. NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS=0 isolates per-NIC behavior; do NOT set NCCL_NET_FORCE_MERGE in the ainic profile together with this (force-merge + merge-disabled => fatal 'Could not force merge NICs'). Validated on g27/g28 (job 9439).

b1_ib._comment: B1: baseline plain RoCE, no AINIC/ionic/CTS.

tests.name: B1_alltoall_IB
tests.description: Baseline plain RoCE alltoall - confirms HW + MPI healthy. Capped at 128M (alltoall >=256M repro lives in disabled b_large_alltoall_repro).

tests.name: B1_allreduce_IB
tests.description: Baseline plain RoCE allreduce.

b2_cast_wrr_ctsoff._comment: B2: explicit CAST, WRR ON, CTS OFF.

tests.name: B2_alltoall_CAST_WRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST WRR ON / CTS OFF - validates multi-QP CAST path on AINIC. Capped at 128M: CAST alltoall >=256M hits IbCastCompletionEventProcess internal error (see b_large_alltoall_repro).

tests.name: B2_allreduce_CAST_WRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST WRR ON / CTS OFF allreduce.

b3_cast_nowrr_ctsoff._comment: B3: CAST, WRR OFF, CTS OFF (isolate scheduler).

tests.name: B3_alltoall_CAST_noWRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST without WRR - isolates scheduler, ionic QP path only. Capped at 128M (CAST alltoall >=256M repro: b_large_alltoall_repro).

tests.name: B3_allreduce_CAST_noWRR_CTSoff
tests.description: CAST without WRR allreduce.

b4_rocmib_ctsoff._comment: B4: ROCM-IB alias, CTS OFF (expected stable AINIC RoCEv2).

tests.name: B4_alltoall_ROCMIB_CTSoff
tests.description: AINIC alias path (sched OFF, CTS OFF). Capped at 128M (ROCM-IB alltoall >=256M repro: b_large_alltoall_repro).

tests.name: B4_allreduce_ROCMIB_CTSoff
tests.description: AINIC alias allreduce.

b5_rocmib_ctson._comment: B5: ROCM-IB alias, CTS ON (hang repro candidate).

tests.name: B5_alltoall_ROCMIB_CTSon
tests.description: CTS ON on P2P - hang repro via CTS table overflow at large sizes.

tests.name: B5_allreduce_ROCMIB_CTSon
tests.description: CTS ON allreduce.

b6_cast_wrr_ctson._comment: B6: CAST, WRR ON + CTS requested ON (CTS should be forced off when sched active).

tests.name: B6_alltoall_CAST_WRR_CTSon
tests.description: WRR ON + CTS requested - verifies CTS forced OFF under active scheduler. Capped at 128M (CAST alltoall >=256M repro: b_large_alltoall_repro).

tests.name: B6_allreduce_CAST_WRR_CTSon
tests.description: WRR ON + CTS requested allreduce.

b7_autodetect._comment: B7: out-of-the-box - NCCL_NET intentionally OMITTED (do NOT set it to '' - the runner exports -x NCCL_NET='' which breaks net init). RCCL_AINIC_ROCE=1 comes from the --system ainic profile. NOTE: on this AINIC cluster autodetect selects netIbCast with CTS on and reproduces the alltoall hang (validated on job 9437); expect TIMEOUT until the CTS fix lands.

tests.name: B7_alltoall_autodetect
tests.description: Out-of-the-box: auto-select netIbCast on AINIC HW, stock defaults. Capped at 128M (autodetect=>CAST alltoall >=256M repro: b_large_alltoall_repro).

tests.name: B7_allreduce_autodetect
tests.description: Out-of-the-box autodetect allreduce.

b7a_pure_autodetect._comment: B7a: pure PCI autodetect. NCCL_NET omitted; RCCL_AINIC_ROCE must ALSO be absent. The runner cannot unset a profile var via '', so run this config WITHOUT '--system ainic' (or with a profile that does not set RCCL_AINIC_ROCE) so detection is purely PCI-based (0x1dd8:0x10) and libionic.so auto-loads.

tests.name: B7a_alltoall_pure_autodetect
tests.description: Pure PCI autodetect (0x1dd8:0x10); libionic.so auto-loads. Capped at 128M (CAST alltoall >=256M repro: b_large_alltoall_repro).

tests.name: B7a_allreduce_pure_autodetect
tests.description: Pure PCI autodetect allreduce.

b7b_autodetect_off._comment: B7b: negative control - plugin unset (NCCL_NET omitted), AINIC forced OFF via RCCL_AINIC_ROCE=0; expect fallback to plain IB/RoCE.

tests.name: B7b_alltoall_autodetect_off
tests.description: AINIC forced OFF - verifies fallback to plain IB/RoCE on same HW. Capped at 128M for parity with the rest of the sweep.

tests.name: B7b_allreduce_autodetect_off
tests.description: AINIC forced OFF allreduce.

b8_no_cts_offload._comment: B8: ROCM-IB with CTS offload fully disabled.

tests.name: B8_alltoall_ROCMIB_noOffload
tests.description: CTS offload disabled - isolates ionic path without CTS handshake. Capped at 128M (ROCM-IB alltoall >=256M repro: b_large_alltoall_repro).

tests.name: B8_allreduce_ROCMIB_noOffload
tests.description: CTS offload disabled allreduce.

b_large_alltoall_repro._comment: DISABLED repro of a real RCCL bug: CAST/ROCM-IB alltoall fails at >=256M with 'NET/IB: IbCastCompletionEventProcess: Receiver expected a recv request but got Unused (IBV_WC_RECV_RDMA_WITH_IMM) -> internal error', and leaves orphaned ranks on the GPUs. The plain-IB control passes to 8G, proving HW/MPI are healthy and the defect is in the CAST P2P completion path. Enable only to reproduce/triage; expect the two CAST/ROCM-IB cases to FAIL. Observed on g27/g28 (job 9439).

tests.name: BR_alltoall_IB_8G_control
tests.description: CONTROL: plain RoCE alltoall to 8G - expected PASS (HW healthy).

tests.name: BR_alltoall_CAST_8G
tests.description: CAST alltoall to 8G - expected FAIL at >=256M (IbCastCompletionEventProcess internal error).

tests.name: BR_alltoall_ROCMIB_8G
tests.description: ROCM-IB alltoall to 8G - expected FAIL at >=256M (same defect via alias).

test_configurations._comment_group_c: === GROUP C: IONIC hardware counter validation. ===

tests.name: C1_alltoall_counters
tests.description: IONIC counters (tx_rdma_ucast_bytes) non-zero and BW > 10 GB/s. Capped at 128M to avoid the CAST/ROCM-IB alltoall >=256M defect (see b_large_alltoall_repro); 128M is ample for counter validation.

tests.name: C1_allreduce_counters
tests.description: IONIC counter validation on allreduce.
